value: I8 can only\s+(?:be\s+)?used as immediate value for intrinsic
note: The reported symptom IS a diagnostic (DXIL validator rule TYPES.I8, docs/DXIL.rst), so the clause quotes that diagnostic -- this is the 'diagnostic-quality issue' case from the skill, not an internal_failure. The exit code is ordinary E_FAIL (0x80004005), the same as any diagnosed validation error, so is_internal_failure() correctly says this is NOT a crash: the validator caught the optimizer's mistake exactly as designed. MEASURED WORDING CHANGE ACROSS RELEASES (this is why the regex is loose, per the skill's 'message text is not portable, especially at the oldest release' warning): v1.4.1907 prints 'I8 can only used as immediate value for intrinsic' (no 'be', pointer-address + block-name format, e.g. 'at 0x... inside block switch.hole_check of function ShaderDomain_Cs'), while v1.5.2010 onward (and main-debug) print 'I8 can only be used as immediate value for intrinsic or as i8* via bitcast by lifetime intrinsics.' plus a 'note: at %N = trunc i32 %M to i8 in block ...' line. An earlier draft of this predicate required the literal 'be used' text AND a 'trunc i32 ... to i8' regex clause; both are ABSENT from v1.4.1907's output even though it is demonstrably the same TypesI8 defect on the same shader, so that stricter predicate mis-scored v1.4.1907 as no-repro and bisect reported a false 'regressed-in v1.5.2010'. The corrected regex keeps only the wording-stable core ('I8 can only [be] used as immediate value for intrinsic') and drops the trunc-instruction anchor, since that IR-shape detail is not printed by the oldest release's diagnostic at all. Self-test / control: control-no-holes.hlsl and control-const-default.hlsl (run with --expect no-match) are ordinary switches over the same case count that do not need the optimizer's lookup-table 'hole check' mask, and must not match on any release.
